cues.en: Episode 4 of the History Channel's show, Unidentified Inside America's UFO Investigation, centres around three videos, commonly referred to as Nimitz, Go Fast, and Gimbal. All three videos were extensively analysed on Metabunk over a year ago. Nimitz is probably just a distant jet. Gimbal is also probably a distant jet, but this time with a rotating glare that's just an artefact of the gimbal-mounted camera system.
cues.zh: 历史频道节目《未确认：美国UFO调查内幕》第4集围绕三段视频展开，通常称为 Nimitz、Go Fast 和 Gimbal。这三段视频一年多前都在 Metabunk 上被详细分析过。Nimitz 很可能只是一架远处的喷气机。Gimbal 很可能也是一架远处的喷气机，但这次带有旋转眩光，那只是万向架相机系统产生的伪影。

cues.en: But what I want to discuss here is the Go Fast video. This video appears to show an object flying very close to the water, which is how it's presented on Unidentified. This description is repeated on the To The Stars Academy page, where the video was first released. A white oval shape moving at high speed, flying very low over the water. But is it really low and fast?
cues.zh: 但这里我想讨论的是 Go Fast 视频。这段视频看起来显示一个物体飞得离水面非常近，节目《未确认》就是这样呈现的。视频最初发布的 To The Stars Academy 页面上也重复了这一描述。一个白色椭圆形物体高速移动，在水面上方飞得很低。但它真的又低又快吗？

cues.en: No, it's not. It's actually high and slow. And we can prove this with the information in the video. There's a bunch of numbers on screen. The altitude of the jet is pretty constant at 25,000 feet. The calibrated airspeed in the lower left is also fairly constant at around 255 knots, which gives a true airspeed of 370 knots when you correct for the 25,000 feet pressure altitude. The jet is flying straight at first.
cues.zh: 不，并不是。实际上它又高又慢。而且我们可以用视频里的信息证明这一点。屏幕上有一堆数字。喷气机的高度相当稳定，在25,000英尺。左下角的校准空速也基本稳定在约255节；按25,000英尺气压高度修正后，真空速为370节。喷气机一开始是直线飞行的。

cues.en: But after locking on, it banks about 13 degrees to the left. I extracted this information by feature tracking the ends of the horizon line. So the jet's turning a little bit to the left. The number at the top is the angle of the camera relative to the front of the jet. It goes from 35 degrees left to 58 degrees left. The number in the middle left is the camera's downward tilt. It goes from 22 degrees down to 35 degrees down.
cues.zh: 但锁定之后，它向左倾斜了约13度。我通过对地平线两端做特征跟踪提取了这个信息。所以喷气机稍微向左转了一点。顶部的数字是相机相对于机头方向的角度。它从向左35度变到向左58度。左侧中部的数字是相机的向下俯仰角。它从向下22度变到向下35度。

cues.en: One of the more important numbers here is the range number on the right hand side labeled RNG. This is the distance to the target in nautical miles. It does not show up until the target is acquired, but then it goes from 4.4 nautical miles to 3.3 nautical miles. So we can use all these numbers and how they change over time to do two things. Firstly, we can calculate how high the object is. That isn't too complicated.
cues.zh: 这里一个比较重要的数据，是右侧标记为 RNG 的距离数值。它表示目标的距离，单位是海里。只有在锁定目标后，这个数值才会显示出来，随后会从 4.4 海里下降到 3.3 海里。所以，我们可以利用这些数据及其随时间的变化，完成两件事。首先，可以计算出这个物体的高度。这并不复杂。

cues.en: We know the angle the camera is looking down at, and we know the distance to the object. So the height of the object below the camera is really just simple trigonometry. It's the range multiplied by the sine of the downward angle. If you take the object at the start and the end of the tracking, we get 4.4 nautical miles times the sine of 26 degrees gives us 1.92 nautical miles below the plane. Then at the end...
cues.zh: 我们知道摄像机向下观察的角度，也知道物体的距离。因此，计算物体相对于摄像机的高度差，其实只需要简单的三角函数。用距离乘以向下俯视角的正弦值即可。如果取跟踪开始和结束时物体的数据，4.4 海里乘以 26 度的正弦值，得到的就是飞机下方 1.92 海里。到了跟踪结束时……

cues.en: 3.4 nautical miles times the sign of 35 degrees gives us 1.95 nautical miles, about the same. Then it's an object that's around 13,000 feet above the water. And it's also being viewed from a jet at 25,000 feet. So basically it's halfway between the jet and the ocean surface. This is very important because it means the perceived motion of the object against the ocean surface
cues.zh: 3.4 海里乘以 35 度的正弦值，得到 1.95 海里，数值基本相同。这说明该物体位于海面上方约 13,000 英尺处。而观测它的喷气式飞机飞行高度为 25,000 英尺。所以，简单来说，它正好处于飞机和海面之间的大约一半位置。这一点非常重要，因为这意味着物体相对于海面的视觉运动……

cues.en: even if it were moving very slowly, or even if it were not moving at all, would be the same as the speed of the jet itself. This parallax effect is hugely magnified by the high zoom, which is set to NAR, narrow, or around 1.5 degrees field of view. So, we've already seen the unidentified analysis is wrong. It's not close to the water at all. It's at 13,000 feet. But is it as they say?
cues.zh: 即使它移动得非常缓慢，甚至完全静止，看起来也会与喷气式飞机本身的速度相同。高倍变焦会大幅放大这种视差效应，而这里的变焦设置为 NAR，也就是窄视场，视野角度约为 1.5 度。到这里，我们已经知道，所谓的未识别目标分析是错误的。它根本不在海面附近，而是位于 13,000 英尺的高空。但它真的如他们所说的那样吗？

cues.en: It's hauling ass. That's exactly my point. It's a little less than two-thirds the speed of sound. Hauling ass and two-thirds the speed of sound. No, it's not even close. It's going as slow as 20 to 40 knots. Just wind speed at that altitude. We can determine this with some slightly more complex analysis. So we know that the jet and the object maintain constant altitude. The object at 13,000 feet, the jet at 26,000 feet. So we can restrict the analysis
cues.zh: 快得离谱。这正是我的观点。它略低于音速的三分之二。快得离谱和音速的三分之二。不，差得远呢。它的速度只有20到40节。就是那个高度的风速。我们可以通过稍微复杂一点的分析来确定这一点。我们知道喷气机和物体保持恒定高度。物体在13000英尺，喷气机在26000英尺。所以我们可以把分析

cues.en: of the speed of the object to an overhead view. Now, given the range and the angle relative to the front of the jet, we can plot an initial position for that object relative to the jet. Then we know the speed of the jet and the time of the locked portion of the video, so we can plot where it will be at the end of the video. Then using the final range in the angles, we can plot the end position of the object. We can then divide this distance traveled by the time and we get the speed of the object.
cues.zh: 限制在俯视图上。现在，给定距离和相对于喷气机前方的角度，我们可以标出物体相对于喷气机的初始位置。然后我们知道喷气机的速度和视频锁定部分的时间，所以我们可以标出视频结束时它将在哪里。然后利用最终距离和角度，我们可以标出物体的最终位置。然后我们可以把这个移动距离除以时间，就得到物体的速度。

cues.en: This depends on how much the jet is turning to the left, but putting in a reasonable turn rate, and we get the object speeds in the range of 20 to 40 knots, maybe a bit more, but it's all consistent with wind speed of 13,000 feet, not another jet, and certainly not too thirsty speed of sound. We can also make a rough estimate of the size of the object based on the field of view, the range, and the fraction of the field of view covered by the object. This gives us a size of about six or seven feet, about the size of, say, a weather balloon.
cues.zh: 这取决于喷气机向左转了多少，但代入一个合理的转向速率，我们得到物体的速度在20到40节范围内，可能稍多一点，但都与13000英尺的风速一致，而不是另一架喷气机，当然也远不是音速。我们还可以根据视野、距离以及物体覆盖视野的比例，粗略估计物体的大小。这给出大约六到七英尺的大小，大约比如说一个气象气球的大小。

cues.en: In unidentified they noticed that the craft appears cold on the infrared and the narrator says There is no known aircraft that can stay aloft for long without a source of lift and propulsion Which is false because there's an obvious type of aircraft a helium balloon which appears cold the infrared and can stay aloft for hours even days You can also look like it's moving really fast over the ground when it's actually just parallax Here's another example where a balloon is clearly just a balloon. It's also barely moving
cues.zh: 在“未确认”节目中，他们注意到该飞行器在红外图像上显得冰冷，旁白说：“目前已知没有任何飞行器能在没有升力和推进力来源的情况下长时间停留在空中。”这是错误的，因为有一种显而易见的飞行器——氦气球，它在红外图像上显得冰冷，而且能停留数小时甚至数天。它在地面上看起来移动得很快，其实只是视差效应。再看另一个例子，那里明显就是个气球，它几乎没怎么动，

cues.en: and it looks like it's moving really fast. Balloons themselves don't reflect radar, but weather balloons carry radar reflectors, which will be very easy for the range-finding radar to look onto. And finally, in the Defence Department's Form 1910 that authorised public release of this video, the description specifically mentions balloons. Does this solve this one particular video? Not 100%, but it's a quite plausible answer that people are ignoring. Maybe they just didn't do the math?
cues.zh: 但看起来却像是在飞快移动。气球本身不反射雷达，但气象气球会携带雷达反射器，测距雷达很容易就能锁定它。最后，在国防部批准公开这段视频的1910表格中，描述里特别提到了气球。这是否解开了这个特定视频的谜团？不100%确定，但这是一个相当合理的解释，而人们却忽视了它。也许他们只是没算过这笔账？

cues.en: Maybe they didn't like the answer, but you can't ignore it as a possibility.
cues.zh: 也许他们不喜欢这个答案，但你不能忽视这种可能性。
